mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_log (task_id, workspace_id, actor_id, action, detail, from_column, to_column) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{workspaceId}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{detail}, #{fromColumn}, #{toColumn})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.task_id, l.workspace_id, l.actor_id, l.action, l.detail, l.from_column, l.to_column, l.created_at, u.display_name AS actor_name FROM task_log l LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = l.actor_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT from_column FROM task_log WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND action = 'move' AND to_column = 'done' AND from_column IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task_log WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND task_id IN #{taskId}
